answers.notes: I play a little guitar and want to sing too.

note: A demo week for a beginner who sings and plays: three practice days of about 35 minutes, each the library's beginner guitar and voice blocks side by side. Every day opens with the voice warm-up, has two or three guitar blocks in the middle and ends with a tune sung over chords.

plan.title: Week 1: three chords, a first scale and Do Mi Sol
plan.summary: Three practice days of about 35 minutes, half guitar and half voice. Day 1 is the G, C and D chords in time, the A minor pentatonic scale and step tunes sung over a drone. Day 2 makes chords smaller and adds the skip from Do to Sol. Day 3 adds a strumming pattern, a jam over two chords, and Sol and La.
plan.progress:
Basic chords: G, C and D change in time; A5, D5 and E5 as power chords; G, C and D as triads; the full strumming pattern on G, Em, C and D. Next: all seven open chords in any order.
Scales: the A minor pentatonic scale from the root on the low E string, phrases of your own and a jam over Am and G. Next: down-up picking.
Pitch: Do held over a drone, sung in a smooth spot. Next: Do Mi Sol in new keys.
Intervals: steps and skips told apart, the 3rd and the 5th, then the 6th. Next: skips falling.
Melodies: step tunes, a skipping tune, Sol La Sol, each then sung over chords. Next: a tune under Do.
